marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 棟仁的時光 = Stealing seconds. Episode 1-20 | Dong ren de shi guang = Stealing Seconds. Episode 1-20

The burdens of life are so crushing for Tsang Tung-Yan (Benjamin Yuen) that he almost dies one day. Fortunately, he is saved by a paramedic Ching Man-Kei (Natalie Tong) who performs CPR on him. After that, Tung-Yan finds himself capable of stealing the time of the others through kissing to extend his own life, resulting in a major life change. Yet, Man-Kei pays a heavy price. To help Man-Kei pull herself together, Tung-Yan takes over a coffee shop, and gets to know Law Shui-Lam (Hubert Wu) and Mok Hei-Lin (Rebecca Zhu) in the process
